behavior.ordering: Same server is serialized/reused. Different servers can initialize concurrently. Published tool order follows configuration order. Failed discovery publishes no partial tool snapshot.
behavior.disableBoundary: Config status, config key and connection ownership are checked after awaiting connect. Per-server epochs invalidate queued/in-flight operations. Already dispatched remote side effects cannot be rolled back.
behavior.cleanup: Transient connections remain tracked until cleanup succeeds; failed named cleanup remains owned and shutdown can retry. Direct child exit is awaited independently of inherited pipe close; pipes are explicitly destroyed.
